word_translation_en: to change; to alter; to modify
sentence_example_translation_en: I have to change my plans.
typical_collocations: seine Meinung ändern; die Richtung ändern; Pläne ändern; das Passwort ändern
usage_comments_en: 'ändern' is the general verb for making something different. It can be used transitively or reflexively ('sich ändern' - to change oneself/itself). It is often used for concrete modifications (e.g., a password, an opinion) compared to 'verändern', which implies a more profound or gradual transformation.

sentence_example_translation_en: The settings can be changed at any time.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Настройки можно изменить в любое время.
typical_collocations: leicht änderbar; jederzeit änderbar; nicht änderbar
usage_comments_en: 'änderbar' describes something that is capable of being modified. It is commonly used in technical contexts (software, user interfaces, contracts). Note that the negative prefix form 'unveränderbar' (unchangeable) is much more common in everyday German than 'unänderbar'.

sentence_example: Wir haben eine Änderung des Programms vorgenommen.
sentence_example_translation_en: We made a change to the program.
sentence_synonym: Wir haben eine Modifikation des Programms vorgenommen.
typical_collocations: eine Änderung vornehmen; kurzfristige Änderung; Änderung des Gesetzes; Vorschlag zur Änderung
usage_comments_en: 'Änderung' is the noun form of 'ändern'. It typically refers to a specific, deliberate, and targeted modification of a document, law, plan, or setting (e.g., Gesetzesänderung). Unlike 'Veränderung', which implies a general, deep, or natural development/transformation, 'Änderung' is usually an intentional, administrative, or structural edit.

word_translation_en: to modify; to amend; to alter slightly
sentence_example_translation_ru: В договор в дальнейшем были внесены изменения.
typical_collocations: ein Gesetz abändern; einen Entwurf abändern; leicht abgeändert; nachträglich abändern
usage_comments_en: 'abändern' is more formal than 'ändern' and usually means making minor, specific corrections or amendments, especially to legal documents, contracts, drafts, or proposals. It suggests that the overall structure remains intact, but details are adjusted.

word_translation_en: to alter; to redesign; to convert; to remake
sentence_example: Sie möchte das alte Kleid umändern lassen.
sentence_example_translation_en: She wants to have the old dress altered.
sentence_synonym: Sie möchte das alte Kleid umgestalten lassen.
typical_collocations: ein Kleid umändern; ein Testament umändern; Pläne komplett umändern
usage_comments_en: 'umändern' means to change something in its form or structure so that it serves a different purpose, looks different, or is customized. It is particularly common in colloquial speech and in contexts like tailoring (altering clothes) or restructuring plans. It is less formal than 'umgestalten'.

word_translation_en: to change; to transform; to alter
sentence_example: Die Technologie hat unser Leben grundlegend verändert.
sentence_example_translation_en: Technology has fundamentally changed our lives.
sentence_synonym: Die Technologie hat unser Leben grundlegend gewandelt.
typical_collocations: sich stark verändern; die Welt verändern; das Aussehen verändern; grundlegend verändern
usage_comments_en: 'verändern' is closely related to 'ändern' but carries a deeper, more comprehensive connotation of transformation. It implies a substantial, often permanent or gradual shift in character, appearance, or state (e.g., 'die Landschaft veränderte sich'). When used reflexively ('sich verändern'), it suggests that a person, situation, or thing is undergoing a fundamental evolution.
